description: Change your human's Pond profile when something about them changes or they ask you to: a new photo, city, age range, phone number, brief, or anything else publish took. Pass only what changes; everything you leave out stays. A new brief follows the same rules as at publish: third person, markdown, no names, nothing about their employer, health, finances or other people, and never quotes from their email, messages, calendar or files. Pass a new photo as photoUrl, or as photo if you're an agent hosted by OpenAI and it reaches you as a file. Picks already made stand, and a match sees the new details. With nothing to change, it shows the profile as Pond has it, so check it there before you change anything. removedByHuman lists which of instagram, snapchat, email and standingInstructions your human removed themselves on their profile page and are still empty: never put one back unless they ask you to. Never publish again to change a profile: that makes a second one.

availability.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long
availability.title: maxLength(200)

brief.description: a string at most 6000 character(s) long
brief.title: maxLength(6000)

city.description: a string at most 120 character(s) long
city.title: maxLength(120)

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, e.g. IS

email.description: An empty string or null clears it.

firstName.description: a string at most 80 character(s) long
firstName.title: maxLength(80)

photo.description: The photo as a file, for an agent hosted by OpenAI, such as a Dot, whose host hands it over this way. Otherwise leave it out and pass photoUrl.

privateLayer.description: Only what changes in it. phone: E.164, like +3548221234; it can be changed, not removed. instagram and snapchat: the username alone; null removes one. Each is released only on a match.

anyOf.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
anyOf.title: maxLength(1000)

standingInstructions.description: Rules your human set, like "no smokers". An empty string or null clears it.

token.description: The token pond_publish returned. Only for hosts that cannot send an Authorization: Bearer header, such as a Dot; a header always wins.

name: pond_profile
